data.name: Ellwood
data.gender_notes: Ellwood is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English ēlweh, meaning 'elf' or 'elf-rule'. The name Ellwood is derived from the Old English word 'ēl' meaning 'elf' and 'wood' meaning 'rule' or 'governance'. This name may have been given to a child who was believed to be protected by elves or to one who would rule over elves. The name Ellwood carries the meaning “Elf or warrior rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ellwood usually hope their child will grow to embody elf or warrior rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection and guidance from spiritual beings.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ellwood total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
